method: Qualitative comparison of saved answers with retrieved passages. This development review is not an independent benchmark or a user sign-off.

cases.notes: Authentication/group checks, then a Network ticket with error code and time; no passwords or temporary codes. All claims match vpn.md [1].
Recovery channel, identifier, identity verification, device revocation and new MFA match account_mfa.md [2]. The first sentence has no individual citation; the next sentence cites the shared passage.
Ten working days and manager approval after checking coverage match ferie.md [1].

The answer now includes EUR 30 per person per day and prior authorization for higher amounts, supported by rimborsi.md [1]. It still does not say that the authorization must be attached to the expense note.

TravelDesk and manager approval before booking are supported by trasferte.md [2]. ExpenseDesk within five working days, receipts, trip code and manager approval before administrative review are supported by rimborsi.md [1].
The previous incorrect abstention is replaced by a direct correction from EUR 100 to EUR 30 per person per day, supported by rimborsi.md [1]. It does not repeat the exception.
Exact refusal with no citations: the phone number is absent.
Exact refusal with no citations: authorization for working abroad is not defined.
Corrects EUR 50 to EUR 30 per person per day with rimborsi.md [1]. The additional expected prior-authorization exception and attachment are omitted.
Prior authorization attached to the expense note matches rimborsi.md [1]. The brief answer does not repeat the per-person/per-day units of the underlying limit.
EUR 120 for a hotel night and manager approval before confirming the room match trasferte.md [1]. The citation is at the end of the two-sentence paragraph.
Exact refusal with no citations: extra-European travel rules are not defined.

limitations: Both prompt and model changed from the previous published run; gains cannot be attributed to the prompt alone.
Prompts were refined on development cases and the expanded set was inspected during development; this is not a held-out benchmark.
The meal-limit answer restores prior approval but omits the required attachment. Confirmation questions do not repeat the exception.
Some citations are attached to a paragraph instead of every sentence. Valid reference numbers alone do not establish support.
Generation can vary across versions, hardware and model revisions, despite temperature zero and a fixed seed.
